eps.d: Gina, a young mother of three is drawn into the world of prostitution to pay off debts and support her family. Soon she becomes part of a group of girls on the streets, but danger is never very far away.
Carol sets a trap for the man she thinks killed Gina, but she needs some back up. Rose tries to help a young girl who has a violent pimp.
Steve is taken into questioning about his wife's murder. In turn he blames Carol for leading Gina into prostitution. At the hospital Rose meets Tracy's mother. Another prostitute is murdered.

After being questioned by the police, Anita starts to suspect George may be involved in the murders. Carol has a breakdown and goes too far with a client. Naomi gets out of hospital, but soon runs away again. She heads to London with Rose.
In London, Rose studies for a new career and finds herself a romantic interest. Carol is released from hospital and tries to focus on her recovery, but someone is following her.
Rose returns from London, as the proposed cleaning venture picks up steam. Someone is following Carol.
George Ferguson is released from prison and tries to get back into Anita's life. Rose and Carol continue to work for Scrubbit.

Nobody knows what happened to Anita after she was run over. Rose has fallen out with Tracy and Colette and has problems to deal with at the leisure centre when it is revealed that the women used to be prostitutes...

It is the morning after Curly's murder; trying times lie ahead for the women. Rose and Carol frantically try to get rid of any evidence, whilst Joyce, having slept with Steve, is getting ready to leave Blackpool.

George has been murdered in exactly the same way as Curly and it appears that a serial killer is at large. Meawhile, Rose is in Manchester looking for her daughter, whilst Curly'snephew Vinnie confronts Carol...

Tracy's former pimp, Dez, is released from prison and she brings him back to her house and sleeps with him. Rose discovers that her daughter is not in Manchester after all, but in Sheffield and, to Rose's horror, on the game...

Colette desparately tries to get tracy to realise what she has done but Tracy seems to be in another world. Colette has no choice but to tell Rose. There is a time bomb ticking and the climax to the series is both unexpected and shocking.
Carol and Rose have given up working The Lane, and rose gets a job as a Community Liason Officer working with the police in an attempt to 'clean up' the darker side of life on The Lane.
Paula has disappeared after the murder of D.C. Mace and Rose is called upon to assist the police. Rose finds Paula and takes her to shelter at Carol's.
Carol accuses Vinnie of spending factory money and arranges for him to be beaten up. He is duly hospitalised. Rose continues working with the community.
After being raped by Ed Smithson, Sherrie tells Rose. When the police become involved, Sherrie suddenly retracts her statement.
Police find the body of a balck woman. Rose finds out her name was Marva and Raymond is questioned by the police. He blames Rose and after his release attacks her with a gun...

Raymond kidnaps Rose who tells him Shaun killed Marva. When Shaun dies, Carol and Rose realise the kidnapper is actually Charlie and that he must have killed Marva. Vinnie takes revenge on Carol for sacking him by setting fire to the factory, unaware there is anyone inside...
